Deep dives/Heat/Erik Spoelstra

Coach's board · Miami Heat

Erik Spoelstra

Heat head coach since 2008. The Heat are 4–6, 8th in the East.

Heat at Clippers · Nov 4 · end of overtime

Klay's corner three

The out-of-timeout play that beat the Clippers in overtime, drawn on the board.

  1. The timeout. Down 116–114, 3.3 seconds left in overtime. Spoelstra draws one up.
  2. The pin screen. Thompson screens first, pinning a defender so a teammate can pop out.
  3. The baseline run. Then he runs the baseline, and Adebayo screens his man off him.
  4. The pass. Antetokounmpo hits him in the left corner. Nobody is there.
  5. The shot. Thompson lets it go. Heat win 117–116 with one second left.
